## Mandatory per-run evidence (GLOBAL-AGENT-RUN-PROOF v1)
- [ ] Plan filename/ref, subsection / requirement ID, core user journey.
- [ ] BEFORE vs AFTER SHA, prior/current stage and changed behavior.
- [ ] Core-function proof and real source/staging/live availability.
- [ ] Reuse search (own product and candidate projects), exact paths/SHAs/licenses/safety; reused vs adapted vs scratch and why.
- [ ] Original authoritative CI/test results at exact SHA and production/deployment receipts or explicit unverified status.
- [ ] Overall project DONE / IN PROGRESS / NOT STARTED / BLOCKED, milestone delta and next core task.
See root AGENTS.md; preserve existing approval/production holds.
